items.reader_why: LEGO 'bus | 班车': 班车 on its own is a shuttle/company bus; in the seed 下一班车 the 班 is the measure for scheduled runs. before.known: I know an old man who wanted to ask for help
before.target: 我认识一个老男人，他以前想请求帮助

items.reader_why: 老男人 'old male-person' is not how Chinese says 'an old man' — it sounds crude ('old geezer'). The course's own later LEGO is 老人 'an old man / old person' (S0264L01). Seed + LEGO edit → held.

Second Chinese for 'woman': S0229L01 teaches 'woman | 女人', this LEGO teaches 'woman | 妇人' (妇人 is old-fashioned/literary). Exact ZUT clash: S0230L01U02 'do you know that woman? | 你认识那个女人吗？' vs S0232L01U04 'do you know that woman? | 你认识那个妇人吗'. 老妇人 'old woman' (S0232L02) is fine as a whole chunk; the bare 'woman | 妇人' LEGO is the problem. Never delete a LEGO: options are to grow it to 'old woman | 老妇人' (merge with L02) or give it a distinct English (e.g. 'lady').

ZUT at LEGO level: 'my mother' is taught as 我妈 (S0181L02B01 'my mother | 我妈') and again here as 我妈妈. Both are correct Chinese (妈 is more colloquial), but the same English now has two answers across the course. Kai's call which one 'my mother' maps to.

ZUT at LEGO level: 'my father' is 我爸爸 (S0240L01B02) and here 我父亲 (formal 'father'). Same English, two answers (e.g. S0240L01U11 'you must tell my father | 你必须告诉我爸爸' vs S0266L01U03 'do you know my father? | 你认识我父亲吗？'). Seed 266 'an old friend of my father' is fine either way. Kai's call.

items.reader_why: Exact ZUT clash with S0230L01U02 'do you know that woman? | 你认识那个女人吗？' — see the S0232L01 decision.
LEGO says 'door | 扇' but 扇 is only the measure word for doors/windows; 'door' is 门. The LEGO should be 'that door | 那扇门' (or the intro must say 扇 is the counter). L26-correct: 那扇门 is in the seed.
LEGO says 'a table | 一张' but 一张 is 'one + flat-thing counter'; 'table' is 桌子. Should be 'a table | 一张桌子' (in the seed) or the intro must explain 张.
LEGO 'like to play | 喜欢玩' is not in its seed (你觉得他还能继续玩吗 'do you think he can keep playing?' has no 喜欢) — L26 breach; the seed's new material is 还能继续玩. Kai to decide the re-cut.

before.known: a shop where I can buy some postcards.

items.reader_why: Seed English 'a shop where I can buy some postcards' but Chinese 我想买明信片的商店 says 'a shop where I WANT to buy postcards' (想 = want). Should be 我能买一些明信片的商店 (能 can). Seed edit → Kai (#195 has the matching use row S0461L01U01).

before.known: I told her my room number once but she forgot it.
before.target: 我告诉过她我的房间号码一次，但是她忘了

items.reader_why: 一次 'once' sits after a long object: 我告诉过她我的房间号码一次 is awkward/wrong; with a noun object the frequency goes before it: 我告诉过她一次我的房间号码. Seed edit → Kai.

before.known: it's the least I could do.

items.reader_why: 这是我至少能做的事 is a word-for-word calque of 'the least I could do' and reads as 'this is the thing I at least can do'. Natural Chinese is 这是我起码应该做的 / 这是我最起码能做的. Needs an untaught word, so Kai's call (keep, or re-cut).
